sentences.text_target: Sarah established a strict schedule for her weekly grocery run.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə ɪˈstæblɪʃt ə strɪkt ˈskɛʤul fɔːr hɜːr ˈwikli ˈɡroʊsəri rʌn/
sentences.text_native: Sarah a établi un horaire strict pour ses courses hebdomadaires.

sentences.text_target: She always organizes her pantry before writing down any items.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈɔlweɪz ˈɔrɡəˌnaɪzɪz hɜːr ˈpæntri bɪˈfɔr ˈraɪtɪŋ daʊn ˈɛni ˈaɪtəmz/
sentences.text_native: Elle organise toujours son garde-manger avant de noter le moindre article.

sentences.text_target: Checking the inventory helps her avoid buying unnecessary products.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈʧɛkɪŋ ði ˈɪnvəntɔri hɛlps hɜːr əˈvɔɪd ˈbaɪɪŋ ˌʌnˈsɛsəˌsɛri ˈprɑdəkts/
sentences.text_native: Vérifier l'inventaire l'aide à éviter d'acheter des produits superflus.

sentences.text_target: She browses through a digital flyer to find current discounts.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi braʊzɪz θruː ə ˈdɪʤɪtəl ˈflaɪər tuː faɪnd ˈkɜrənt ˈdɪskaʊnts/
sentences.text_native: Elle feuillette un prospectus numérique pour trouver les réductions en cours.

sentences.text_target: Clipping digital coupons can significantly reduce her total bill.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈklɪpɪŋ ˈdɪʤɪtəl ˈkuˌpɑnz kæn sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli rɪˈdus hɜːr ˈtoʊtəl bɪl/
sentences.text_native: Télécharger des coupons numériques peut réduire considérablement sa facture totale.

sentences.text_target: Today, organic vegetables are featured in a special promotion.
sentences.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ, ɔrˈɡænɪk ˈvɛʤtəbəlz ɑr ˈfiʧərd ɪn ə ˈspɛʃəl prəˈmoʊʃən/
sentences.text_native: Aujourd'hui, les légumes bio font l'objet d'une promotion spéciale.

sentences.text_target: She grabs a heavy trolley near the sliding entrance doors.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ɡræbz ə ˈhɛvi ˈtrɑli nɪr ðə ˈslaɪdɪŋ ˈɛntrəns dɔrz/
sentences.text_native: Elle attrape un lourd chariot près des portes d'entrée coulissantes.

sentences.text_target: The bustling atmosphere reminds her of a busy Saturday morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌsəlɪŋ ˈætməˌsfɪr rɪˈmaɪndz hɜːr ʌv ə ˈbɪzi ˈsætərdi ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: L'atmosphère animée lui rappelle un samedi matin bien rempli.

sentences.text_target: She navigates expertly through the dairy and bakery departments.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈnævəˌɡeɪts ˈɛkspərtli θruː ðə ˈdɛri ænd ˈbeɪkəri dɪˈpɑrtmənts/
sentences.text_native: Elle navigue avec aisance dans les rayons des produits laitiers et de la boulangerie.

sentences.text_target: Checking nutrition labels has become a healthy personal habit.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈʧɛkɪŋ nuˈtrɪʃən ˈleɪbəlz hæz bɪˈkʌm ə ˈhɛlθi ˈpɜrsənəl ˈhæbɪt/
sentences.text_native: Vérifier les étiquettes nutritionnelles est devenu une saine habitude personnelle.

sentences.text_target: When her favorite brand is unavailable, she looks for alternatives.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn hɜːr ˈfeɪvərɪt brænd ɪz ˌʌnəˈveɪləbəl, ʃi lʊks fɔr ɔlˈtɜrnətɪvz/
sentences.text_native: Quand sa marque préférée n'est pas disponible, elle cherche des alternatives.

sentences.text_target: She compares the unit prices to ensure maximum savings.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi kəmˈpɛrz ðə ˈjunɪt ˈpraɪsɪz tuː ɪnˈʃʊr ˈmæksəməm ˈseɪvɪŋz/
sentences.text_native: Elle compare les prix unitaires pour garantir un maximum d'économies.

sentences.text_target: Every single ingredient for her planned dinners goes into the cart.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl ɪnˈɡridiənt fɔr hɜːr plænd ˈdɪnərz ɡoʊz ˈɪntuː ðə kɑrt/
sentences.text_native: Chaque ingrédient de ses dîners prévus va dans le chariot.

sentences.text_target: Household cleaning supplies occupy an entire central aisle.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈhaʊshoʊld ˈklinɪŋ səˈplaɪz ˈɑkjəpaɪ ən ɪnˈtaɪr ˈsɛntrəl aɪl/
sentences.text_native: Les produits d'entretien ménager occupent toute une allée centrale.

sentences.text_target: She carefully estimates the exact quantity of laundry detergent needed.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈkɛrfəli ˈɛstəˌmeɪts ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈkwɑntəti ʌv ˈlɔndri dɪˈtɜrʤənt ˈnidɪd/
sentences.text_native: Elle estime soigneusement la quantité exacte de lessive nécessaire.

sentences.text_target: Calculating her budget constantly prevents any unpleasant financial surprises.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈkælkjuˌleɪtɪŋ hɜːr ˈbʌʤɪt ˈkɑnstəntli prɪˈvɛnts ˈɛni ʌnˈplɛzənt fəˈnænʃəl sərˈpraɪzɪz/
sentences.text_native: Calculer constamment son budget prévient toute mauvaise surprise financière.

sentences.text_target: The heavy glass bottles require careful handling at the bottom.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈhɛvi ɡlæs ˈbɑtəlz rɪˈkwaɪr ˈkɛrfəl ˈhændlɪŋ æt ðə ˈbɑtəm/
sentences.text_native: Les lourdes bouteilles en verre nécessitent une manipulation délicate.

sentences.text_target: Fresh bakery items smell incredible as she passes the ovens.
sentences.phonetic: /frɛʃ ˈbeɪkəri ˈaɪtəmz smɛl ɪnˈkrɛdəbəl æz ʃi ˈpæsɪz ði ˈʌvənz/
sentences.text_native: Les produits de boulangerie frais sentent incroyablement bon lorsqu'elle passe devant les fours.

sentences.text_target: She selects a crusty artisan loaf instead of sliced white bread.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi səˈlɛkts ə ˈkrʌsti ˈɑrtəzən loʊf ɪnˈstɛd ʌv slaɪst waɪt brɛd/
sentences.text_native: Elle choisit une miche de pain artisanal croustillant au lieu de pain blanc tranché.

sentences.text_target: Frozen pizzas and vegetables go into insulated bags immediately.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfroʊzən ˈpitsəz ænd ˈvɛʤtəbəlz ɡoʊ ˈɪntuː ˈɪnsəˌleɪtɪd bæɡz ɪˈmidiətli/
sentences.text_native: Les pizzas surgelées et les légumes vont immédiatement dans des sacs isothermes.

sentences.text_target: The main queues look rather long and somewhat discouraging.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə meɪn kjuːz lʊk ˈræðər lɔŋ ænd ˈsʌmwʌt dɪsˈkɜrɪʤɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Les files d'attente principales ont l'air plutôt longues et un peu décourageantes.

sentences.text_target: Fortunately, an express checkout opens just beside her location.
sentences.phonetic: /fɔrˈʧənətli, ən ɪkˈsprɛs ˈʧɛkaʊt ˈoʊpənz ʤʌst bɪˈsaɪd hɜːr loʊˈkeɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Heureusement, une caisse express ouvre juste à côté d'elle.

sentences.text_target: A friendly cashier greets every customer with a warm smile.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈfrɛndli kæˈʃɪr ɡrits ˈɛvri ˈkʌstəmər wɪð ə wɔrm smaɪl/
sentences.text_native: Un caissier sympathique accueille chaque client avec un sourire chaleureux.

sentences.text_target: The automated scanner rapidly processes each barcode efficiently.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈɔtəˌmeɪtɪd ˈskænər ˈræpɪdli ˈprɑsɛsɪz iʧ ˈbɑrˌkoʊd ɪˈfɪʃəntli/
sentences.text_native: Le scanner automatisé traite rapidement chaque code-barres de manière efficace.

sentences.text_target: A helpful bagger organizes the plastic bags according to weight.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈhɛlpfəl ˈbæɡər ˈɔrɡəˌnaɪzɪz ðə ˈplæstɪk bæɡz əˈkɔrdɪŋ tuː weɪt/
sentences.text_native: Un emballeur serviable range les sacs en plastique en fonction du poids.

sentences.text_target: Sarah pays conveniently using her contactless payment card.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsærə peɪz kənˈvinjəntli ˈjuːzɪŋ hɜːr ˈkɑntæktlɪs ˈpeɪmənt kɑrd/
sentences.text_native: Sarah paie facilement en utilisant sa carte de paiement sans contact.

sentences.text_target: She accepts the printed receipt and tucks it safely inside her wallet.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi əkˈsɛpts ðə ˈprɪntɪd rɪˈsit ænd tʌks ɪt ˈseɪfli ɪnˈsaɪd hɜːr ˈwɑlət/
sentences.text_native: Elle prend le ticket de caisse imprimé et le range en lieu sûr dans son portefeuille.

sentences.text_target: Pushing the heavy cart outside, she heads toward her vehicle.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ ðə ˈhɛvi kɑrt ˌaʊˈsaɪd, ʃi hɛdz təˈwɔrd hɜːr ˈviɪkəl/
sentences.text_native: Poussant le lourd chariot dehors, elle se dirige vers son véhicule.

sentences.text_target: She opens the car trunk and loads all the groceries carefully.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃi ˈoʊpənz ðə kɑr trʌŋk ænd loʊdz ɔl ðə ˈɡroʊsəriz ˈkɛrfəli/
sentences.text_native: Elle ouvre le coffre de la voiture et charge toutes les courses avec soin.

sentences.text_target: Driving back home, she feels satisfied with a well-managed shopping trip.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdraɪvɪŋ bæk hoʊm, ʃi filz ˈsætɪsˌfaɪd wɪð ə wɛl-ˈmænəʤd ˈʃɑpɪŋ trɪp/
sentences.text_native: En rentrant chez elle, elle se sent satisfaite de ses courses rondement menées.
